content.description: Illustration showing parking brake lever connection to cable on rear brake assembly

items.heading: CONNECT PARKING BRAKE LEVER TO CABLE
items.text: Compress the cable spring and connect the lever.

items.heading: INSTALL REAR SHOE
items.text: Slide in the rear shoe between the shoe hold-down spring seat and the backing plate.

content.text: CAUTION: Do not allow oil or grease to touch the rubbing face.

content.description: Top-down view showing tension spring installation between front and rear brake shoes

items.heading: INSTALL TENSION SPRING, FRONT SHOE AND SHOE ADJUSTING SCREW SET
substeps: (a) Install the tension spring to the rear shoe.
(b) Install the front shoe to the tension spring.
(c) Install the shoe adjusting screw set between the front and rear shoes.

content.description: Illustration showing front shoe installation between shoe hold-down spring seat and backing plate

content.text: (d) Slide in the front shoe between the shoe hold-down spring seat and the backing plate.

content.description: Rear view diagram of brake drum assembly showing front and rear shoe return spring positions
Illustration showing rear disc and brake assembly installation on axle

items.heading: INSTALL REAR DISC
substeps: (a) Before installing, polish the disc and shoe surfaces with sandpaper.
(b) Align the groove on the rear axle shaft flange and service hole on the disc.
